svg.aria-label: Four excretory organs drawn side by side and numbered I to IV. I, an irregular cell with short branching processes and a nucleus, holding a hollow with a tuft of cilia shaped like a candle flame, which opens into a narrow tubule running down to the right. II, a bean-shaped organ cut lengthwise, with a stippled outer layer, five striped cone-shaped pyramids pointing in to a central space, two vessels leaving at the notch on the right, and a tube running down from the notch. III, a small funnel fringed with cilia, joined by a thin tube to a coil of long looped tubes, the last one wide, ending in a rounded bladder with a short duct. IV, a gut tube coming down from the top, with two long, slender, blind-ending tubules arching out from it on either side, and the gut continuing down into a swollen chamber
